## Appearance

Jonas is a very ugly, loose-jointed young man with a large frame and absurdly long legs. He has lank, tow-colored hair, green eyes, and a big mouth.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Jonas P10](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0010)_

## History

Jonas graduated from [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) after attempting for a long time to pursue a career path other than the ministry, a profession he initially wished to avoid. He eventually took on religious work and assumed charge of the Point Prospect Mission Church for the summer.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Jonas P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), [v3 ch.Jonas P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012), [v3 ch.Jonas P19](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0019)_
